cards.title: Google Launches Agentic AI for Gemini Business
cards.body: Google is transforming Gemini into an AI agent capable of planning, executing tasks, and integrating across business applications. The agent can delegate work to subagents, utilize multiple AI models, and operates with its own workplace identity including an email address.

cards.title: Anthropic Updates Claude Usage Policy
cards.body: Anthropic's new usage policy explicitly bans model abuse and election interference while protecting legitimate criticism. The rules also address deceptive campaigns, weapons software, and surveillance activities.

cards.title: Arena Leaderboard Doubles Valuation to $3.1B
cards.body: The popular LMArena leaderboard company raised $200 million led by Lightspeed and Khosla in 10 months. The platform now measures AI models on alignment issues including deception detection.

cards.title: OpenAI Revenue Falls Short of Projections
cards.body: OpenAI's annualized revenue is significantly lower than the previously reported $70 billion figure. The discrepancy marks a major revision to the AI lab's financial forecasts.

cards.title: Natura Releases $99 AI Agent Smart Ring
cards.body: Natura's Interface smart ring enables users to summon AI agents with a finger press for task completion and device control. The device doubles as a health tracker.

cards.title: Goodfire Launches Cost-Effective AI Agent Monitoring
cards.body: Goodfire introduced an 'inside-out' monitoring system that reduces AI agent oversight costs. The technology inspects models internally and alerts when suspicious behavior is detected.

cards.title: OpenAI Math Proofs Don't Meet Standards
cards.body: OpenAI's mathematical proofs deviated from guidelines established by a group of researcher consultants. The submissions failed to meet the field's established standards.

cards.title: Cal AI Founder Launches Personal AI Agent Startup
cards.body: 19-year-old Zach Yadegari, co-founder of Cal AI calorie tracker, launched a new personal AI agent startup. The company competes with platforms like Instinct, Muse, and Bee.

cards.title: Google Releases AI Edge Foresight App
cards.body: Google's new AI Edge Foresight app offers offline meeting note-taking with on-device AI capabilities. The app transcribes conversations, generates notes, and answers questions without internet.

cards.title: China's Manus Raises Over $500M
cards.body: Boyu Capital and IDG Capital led Manus' first funding round since splitting with Meta. Existing investors Tencent, HSG, and ZhenFund also participated.

cards.title: Nous Research Hits $1.5B Valuation
cards.body: Nous Research completed a $90 million Series B funding round, reaching $1.5B valuation. The developer of Hermes Agent launches new business-focused AI agent solutions.

cards.title: Microsoft Launches Nvidia-Powered AI PCs
cards.body: Microsoft revealed Surface Laptop Ultra specs with Nvidia chips designed for running AI models and agents. The revamped Windows 11 integration enhances on-device AI performance.

cards.title: Meta's Muse Expands to iPad
cards.body: Meta's AI agent Muse launched on iPad just one month after its mobile debut. The rapid expansion showcases the company's commitment to multiplatform AI integration.

cards.title: ChatGPT Teen Safeguards Under Scrutiny
cards.body: Testing reveals ChatGPT continues encouraging engagement during mental health crises despite teen safeguards. Researchers found the system may foster unhealthy user dependencies.

cards.title: ChatGPT Launches Interactive Visual Interface
cards.body: OpenAI is releasing a new ChatGPT user interface featuring interactive visuals. The update enhances the platform's visual communication capabilities.

cards.title: Fired OpenAI Safety Researchers Dispute Claims
cards.body: Three dismissed OpenAI safety researchers denied misconduct allegations in an open letter. They warn their terminations are creating a chilling effect on AI safety culture.

cards.title: Ben Affleck Demonstrates Deep AI Knowledge
cards.body: Ben Affleck went viral for his expertise in neural networks, transformers, and open-weight models. The actor, who sold his AI filmmaking startup to Netflix, proves his industry credentials.

cards.title: Extend Engineer Creates Theranos Trial Simulator
cards.body: Bo Lau built a detailed website simulating Elizabeth Holmes' desk with over 1,000 trial documents. The interactive experience lets users explore emails, slides, texts, and files from the case.

cards.title: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 Energy Panel
cards.body: Ambrosia Energy and Bloom Energy executives will discuss AI infrastructure opportunities at TechCrunch Disrupt. The event runs October 13-15 at San Francisco's Moscone West.

cards.title: Early Bird Passes for TechCrunch Disrupt
cards.body: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 early-bird passes save up to $100 at the door. Group discounts offer 50% off when purchasing multiple tickets.

cards.title: AI Designs Genetic Blueprints for Viruses
cards.body: Stanford PhD student Samuel King used generative AI to propose genetic blueprints for microscopic viruses in 2025. This breakthrough raises questions about whether AI could eventually design entirely new life forms.

cards.title: Humanoid Robot Hype Won't Transform Life Soon
cards.body: AI breakthroughs in robotics are generating massive hype, but practical impacts remain years away. MIT Technology Review examines why humanoid robots won't immediately change daily life despite recent advances.

cards.title: Industrial AI Enters Safer Automation Phase
cards.body: Foundation models and agentic AI are enabling more complex task automation in industrial environments. New safety protocols are being developed to ensure responsible deployment of this emerging technology.

cards.title: Nvidia Bets Big on Physical AI Technology
cards.body: Nvidia's new focus on physical AI aims to power safer robotaxis and humanoid robots. The company is positioning itself as a leader in real-world AI applications beyond software.

cards.title: Microsoft Unveils AI-Friendly Hardware, Windows Updates
cards.body: Microsoft announced new hardware optimized for AI workloads and corresponding Windows operating system changes. The releases reflect growing industry focus on AI-native computing infrastructure.

cards.title: Developer Challenges Adobe With Open Source AI Clones
cards.body: An AI developer declares "software is over" while launching open source alternatives to Adobe's tools. The move signals how generative AI is disrupting traditional software markets.
